reading.action: Pull out the Stalker eye-lenses and look through them at the haven from the threshold, to see if that changes anything (not entering).
reading.result: EYE-LENS REVEAL (deterministic item property, iris-prep ruling). The lenses drink the haven's false gold -> the threshold lie DIMS and he sees the honest substrate DIRECTLY: dead cold hearth, true dimness, bones plain, the welcoming host thinned to a HOLLOW PROJECTION (an empty image — the real predator stays HELD-DARK). His deduced strong-read becomes direct SIGHT. BOUNDED to threshold line-of-sight (no seeing into deeper rooms); NOT a master key (deeper ladder fakes shadow/heat/reflection, which light-drinking can't expose). CONSEQUENCE CLEAN — no provocation (lens ABSORBS, silent; not a t57 emit). Seeded tradeoff: the lens drinks ALL light incl. his own EMBER, dimming his truest lie-detector to his eye through it (free here, self-limiting deeper). Atmospheric color: a half-second sense the place SEES BACK (foreshadow, not a threat-state change). NO pool/XP/skill/affinity change; lens NOT consumed (property now LEARNED). Ends on the situation — no assume of his next move. NO Tower reset.
